thread:
alice.k: @channel :rotating_light: prod alert - sudden KV cache pages growth and tail latency spike in us-west-2 since ~14:03 UTC. Error rates up on continuous-batching routes, 504s for some customers. I see a few workers with memory > 90% and one pod restarted. logs attached.

brian.m: grabbing logs now. quick grep shows repeated prefix invalidations and heavy cache page allocations: ```kv_cache_alloc_pages=12458932 evt=invalidate prefix_hash=0x9b3a... cause=partial_kv_eviction``` Not normal.

incident-bot: Incident opened INC-2026-032 by alice.k - Severity: P2. Affected: inference-serving-prod-us-west-2 (kv-cache blowup). Pager: eng-oncall.

carla_oncall: i'm on it. Initial assessment: looks like continuous batching config combined with a new model routing pattern caused unbounded KV cache growth when prefix reuse is low. That amplifies memory usage and causes perf cliffs. Plan proposal: 1) quick mitigation - disable continuous batching global flag (ff/batch_continuous_mode) 2) roll a canary disabling to 10% first (internal and canary accounts) 3) per-customer override for heavy customers (acme-corp & beta-ml) set to legacy batching codepath. 4) monitor for 15m, then expand to full rollout if stable. Revert plan is just flip flag back.

pm_jordan: customer-impact note: acme-corp has active SLAs and 3 requests failed in the last 10m. CS alerted Lina to notify them if we expect degradation during mitigations.

cs_lina: pinged acme-corp support; they reported increased latency in their analytics endpoints. I'll keep them updated. No customer-visible errors from dedicated nodes yet but watching.

brian.m: commands to run for quick mitigations (ops API):
```
# disable continuous batching global flag (canary 10%)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" https://ops.internal/featureflags/ff/batch_continuous_mode/toggle -d '{"enabled":false, "canary_pct":10, "note":"hotfix - kv cache blowup"}'

# apply per-customer override
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" https://ops.internal/overrides/customers/acme-corp -d '{"batching_mode":"legacy"}'
```

carla_oncall: executing now. I'll target internal/test accounts + internal-canary first. Deploy-bot, request canary rollout and watch.

deploy-bot: Starting featureflag rollout ff/batch_continuous_mode -> disabled, canary_pct=10. Watch: https://ops.internal/flags/ff/batch_continuous_mode

sre_lee: adding checks: monitor kv_cache_pages_total (per-pod), pod memory, p95/p99 latency for /v1/generate and continuous-batch routes. Alert if mem > 85% or p99 latency > 800ms.

alice.k: also add a quick TTL expiry on KV cache pages if possible, lower to 60s temporarily. Might help while we stabilize.

brian.m: TTL change pushed to config-service: `kv_cache.default_ttl=60` (this is safe fallback). Metrics should reflect new eviction pattern in ~30s.

(about 6 minutes later)

carla_oncall: canary looks good so far - kv_cache_pages per-pod trending down on canary hosts, p99 latency on canary routes dropped from ~1.2s to ~320ms. No restarts. Proceeding to expand to 50%.

deploy-bot: Expanded ff/batch_continuous_mode canary to 50% as requested by carla_oncall.

brian.m: applying per-customer overrides for acme-corp and beta-ml now.

cs_lina: acme-corp confirmed improved latency on their next test. They saw 30-40% reduction in p95.

carla_oncall: ok going to 100% global disable in 5m if metrics steady for 15m. Noting risk: small increase in per-token cost for some paths but preferable to OOMs.

(10 minutes later)

sre_lee: kv_cache_pages_total is stable and trending down cluster-wide. No new OOMs. p99 for continuous routes back to baseline.

carla_oncall: rolling to 100% disable now.

deploy-bot: Rolling ff/batch_continuous_mode -> disabled (100%). Change id: ff-roll-1772559001-1

alice.k: monitoring... looks good. Exporting timeline for postmortem. Important notes for follow-up: 1) why did prefix invalidations spike (routing change?) 2) we need per-route KV cache limits and hard caps 3) test harness for continuous-batching with low prefix reuse workloads.

pm_jordan: I'll coordinate customer comms and include mitigation summary and ETA for a deep dive.

carla_oncall: post-incident actions assigned: briam.m -> debug prefix invalidation root-cause; lee -> add hard caps/eviction policies; eng-runtime -> design per-customer batching overrides; infra -> add mem-based autoscale for workers. We'll open follow-ups in the incidents board.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-032 status -> mitigated. Root cause investigation in progress. Close target in 24h after RCA.

brian.m: quick note - re-enabled continuous batching locally on a dev model to reproduce; I can trigger synthetic low-prefix reuse workload to validate fix paths.

carla_oncall: thanks team. handing back to regular oncall rotation at 15:30 UTC. If anything regresses, page me. :thumbsup:

sre_lee: leaving a short checklist in the ticket with dashboards and queries used.

alice.k: thanks all, good work moving fast and safe.
